title: A canonical section method for conjugacy classes of GL_n(O_2)
summary: Let O be the ring of integers of a non-Archimedean local field with finite residue field, let p be its maximal ideal, and let O_2 = O/p^2. We show that the class equation of GL_n(O_2) depends on O only through the cardinality of its residue field: for two such rings O and O' with isomorphic finite residue fields, there is a canonical bijection between the conjugacy classes of GL_n(O_2) and of GL_n(O'_2) which preserves the size of every class.
